symptom: An empty Local chat's workspace rows or Add chat transcripts row disappeared while the engine was busy or starting, and a sibling chat's new prompt reached that row only after a delay.
rule: Never gate a visible empty state on a read without a bounded fallback: share one persisted Local folder list, overlay prompts this renderer sent, show the workspace rows after a short grace, and paint known-empty chats provisionally after a restart (docs/ui-interaction-performance.md).
